title: Integrate Design Taste as a universal cross-engine skill

REJECTED: universal cross-engine documentation is internally inconsistent. README lines 37-43 say Gemini currently shares the canonical .agents/skills directory, while README line 54 calls that same skill format only a future Gemini/Antigravity interoperability surface. The Gemini adapter inventory names agents, commands, .agents/workflows, and the headless runner but does not state the intended .agents/skills discovery scope, so the unqualified current universal-availability claim is not replayably coherent. The new test only checks path substrings and misses this contradiction. All implementation checks otherwise pass: targeted integration 8/8; Codex integration 6/6 on Python 3.12; full suite 54/54 on Python 3.12; quick_validate passes 3/3 trees; recursive byte parity and upstream MIT hash pass; git diff --check clean; upstream Taste worktree clean. Return to worker to reconcile README and explicitly document/test repo-scoped Gemini consumption versus any installable distribution claim.
DECISION: reconcile current repo-scoped skill discovery across README and GEMINI_ADAPTER; strengthen the integration test against stale future-only wording.

DECISION: document current repo-scoped .agents/skills discovery for Codex and Gemini CLI, separate it from Gemini context-file injection and installable distribution, remove stale future-only wording, and make AGENTS enumerate every canonical skill directory.
